tagline: Little Paris gone wild — the world's heaviest building, a buzzing old town of bars, and the gateway to Dracula's castles.
overview: Bucharest earned the name 'Little Paris' for its belle-époque boulevards — then communism bulldozed a quarter of the centre for the Palace of the Parliament, the world's heaviest building and second-largest administrative building after the Pentagon.

Today's city is a layered mix: Lipscani old town's cobbled lanes now thrum with bars and cafés, the Romanian Athenaeum hosts world-class concerts under a frescoed dome, and parks like Herăstrău wrap the city's lakes.

Speed's 2024 tour streamed from Bucharest. It's also the natural launchpad for Transylvania — Bran (the 'Dracula' castle), Brașov's medieval square and Peleș Castle's carved fantasy are all reachable day trips.

funFacts.title: WORLD'S HEAVIEST BUILDING
funFacts.text: The Palace of the Parliament weighs ~4 million tonnes — and reportedly sinks a few millimetres yearly.

funFacts.title: LITTLE PARIS
funFacts.text: Interwar Bucharest copied Parisian boulevards — its own Arcul de Triumf still stands.

funFacts.title: A QUARTER DEMOLISHED
funFacts.text: Ceaușescu's Civic Centre razed thousands of homes, churches and synagogues for the palace.

funFacts.title: THE ATHENAEUM
funFacts.text: The 1888 concert hall's dome fresco tells Romanian history in a circle.

funFacts.title: DRACULA'S GATEWAY
funFacts.text: Bran Castle — the tourist 'Dracula castle' — is a 3-hour day trip.

funFacts.title: VILLAGE MUSEUM
funFacts.text: Herăstrău Park hosts 270 relocated historic peasant houses and churches.

funFacts.title: REVOLUTION SQUARE
funFacts.text: Ceaușescu's final speech, interrupted by the crowd, happened here in December 1989.

funFacts.title: CARTURESTI CARUSEL
funFacts.text: A restored 19th-century building became Instagram's favourite bookstore.

funFacts.title: MIGRATION CHURCHES
funFacts.text: Communist planners famously moved entire churches on rails to hide them.

funFacts.title: PALINKA & MITITEI
funFacts.text: Plum brandy and skinless grilled sausages fuel the night scene.
